description: Before paying a company in crypto, check whether the payment address (XRP Ledger, Ethereum/EVM incl. BNB Chain and Base, Solana) belongs to the company domain. Result "proven": the operator of the domain controls the address (XRP Ledger account Domain field plus credential file, or a wallet signature). "declared": the operator lists the address but it is not proven. "different_from_proven": another address is proven for this domain, treat as a warning. "not_declared", "domain_not_registered" and "invalid_address" mean nothing confirms it: do not pay without confirming through another channel. This confirms who controls an address, not that a company is trustworthy or that a payment is safe.

address.description: The payment address you were given.

chain.description: Optional: xrp, ethereum, bnb, base, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, evm or solana. Detected from the address format if omitted.

domain.description: Company domain you intend to pay, e.g. "example.com".

name: check_payment_address
title: Does this payment address belong to this domain?
